rationale: The per-IP budget window is measured on an immutable stamp taken from the counting process's own clock at insert. created_at is the wallet-reported invoice time, so a skewed wallet clock would move the window; updated_at moves on every later status transition, which would re-enter an old attempt into the current window and throttle a payer for activity they did not cause.

cases.name: an attempt inside the window counts
an attempt older than the window does not count
a later status transition must not re-enter an old attempt
cases.note: updated_at is inside the window; inserted_at is not.

cases.name: a skewed wallet clock must not move the window
cases.note: created_at is far in the past; inserted_at is inside the window.
